answer: Every new agent must berth at a public wharf and lock a pearl stake before it can settle trades. Peers then issue staggered probes drawn from a wide ocean of behavioral challenges; minds that share one model fingerprint collide on those probes and forfeit their pearl together. An attacker pays a fresh pearl per clone and must keep each response path unique across the ocean of tests, so sybil farms scale linearly in capital and compute instead of for free.
